tasks.title: Create a Basic HTTP Server
tasks.description: Build a server using the core `http` module that responds to different routes with specific JSON payloads.
tasks.hint: Use `http.createServer()` and check `req.url` to determine which route was requested. Remember to set the `Content-Type` header to `application/json`.

tasks.title: Read and Write Files with 'fs'
tasks.description: Use the File System module to perform basic async read/write operations.
requirements: Append a timestamp to a log file.
tasks.hint: Use `fs.readFile()` for reading and `fs.appendFile()` for appending. Always handle errors in the callback.

tasks.title: Build a Simple Event Emitter
tasks.description: Implement your own version of Node's core EventEmitter class from scratch to understand the observer pattern.
requirements: Handle multiple listeners for a single event safely.
tasks.hint: Store listeners in an object where keys are event names and values are arrays of functions. For `once`, wrap the listener to remove itself after first call.

tasks.title: Initialize and Configure a Project
tasks.description: Set up a new Node.js project with proper npm configuration and scripts.
requirements: Install and configure nodemon as a dev dependency.
tasks.hint: Run `npm init -y` to create a package.json, then edit the scripts section.
tasks.solution:
```bash
npm init -y
npm install --save-dev nodemon
```

Then in `package.json`:
```json
"scripts": {
  "start": "node src/index.js",
  "dev": "nodemon src/index.js"
}
```

tasks.title: Create a Utility Package
tasks.description: Build a small reusable utility module and prepare it for publishing.
requirements: Create a module with at least 3 utility functions.
Write a README describing the package.
tasks.hint: Think about common operations like date formatting, string manipulation, or validation.

tasks.title: Convert Callbacks to Promises
tasks.description: Refactor existing callback-based code to use Promises for better readability.
requirements: Wrap a callback-based function in a Promise.
tasks.hint: Create a new function that returns a `new Promise()` and calls the callback-based function inside it.

tasks.title: Build a Custom Event System
tasks.description: Create a typed event emitter with support for wildcard listeners.
requirements: Support wildcard `*` listeners that fire on any event.
Prevent memory leaks by tracking listener counts.
tasks.hint: Use a Map to store listeners. For wildcards, check if a `*` listener exists when any event is emitted.
